items.title: 16.3 Chemicals ke fuzle ko thikane lagane ka nizam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.3, printed page 338.

blocks.text: Kimiyai fuzla (chemical waste) koore ke dabbon ya sewer system mein nahi phenka ja sakta. Zyada tar kimiyai fuzle ko Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) ke in qawaid-o-zawabit ke mutabiq thikane lagana chahiye:

items: Kimiyai fuzle ko munasib containers mein rakhein.
Kimiyai fuzle ke containers par fuzle ki qism, fuzle ki tareekh aur asal jagah ka label lagayein.

Containers ko muqarrar jagah muntaqil karein jahan unhen thikane lagane ke liye munasib tareeqe se treat kiya jata hai: fuzle ke kimiyai treatment mein neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction shamil hain.

blocks.caption: Fuzle ke kimiyai treatments
rows: acid ya alkali fuzla mehfooz pH par laya jata hai
hal shuda nuqsan-deh ions na-halne wale bana kar alag kiye jate hain
nuqsan-deh ions resin par utaar liye jate hain
nuqsan-deh madda mehfooz tar madde mein badla jata hai

blocks.prompt: Kimiyai fuzla kaise thikane lagaya jata hai (Quick Check 16.1b)?
blocks.explanation: Kabhi koore ke dabbon ya sewer mein nahi: ise munasib containers mein rakha jata hai, fuzle ki qism, tareekh aur asal jagah ka label lagaya jata hai, aur muqarrar jagah le jaya jata hai, jahan thikane lagane se pehle neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction se kimiyai treatment hota hai.

items: Kimiyai fuzla: kabhi dabbon ya sewer mein nahi; munasib containers mein rakhein, label (qism, tareekh, asal), muqarrar jagah muntaqil; treatment neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction se (EPA qawaid).
